description:
Advances: specled.prime, specled.next, specled.package

From the pre-ship critical review (consolidated 2026-07-25, CF1 + U9). Tier-1: the taught protocol sentence is FALSE as shipped and is replicated into adopter repos by the bootstrap skill.

VERIFIED BY EXECUTION (consolidator): `mix spec.check --base definitely-not-a-real-ref --no-run-commands 2>&1 | tail -2` puts `** (Mix) --base ... does not resolve to a commit` AFTER the verdict line. Since a failing run always raises, and a terminal interleaves both streams, "The last line is the verdict" is false on every failure path in ordinary use, not just under 2>&1.

Current sentence (25 occurrences, must stay byte-identical everywhere):
"The last line is the verdict — `spec.check result=…`; nothing above it, including `validate status=…`, is the verdict."

Required properties of the replacement:
1. TRUE under merged stdout+stderr and in a terminal.
2. Anchors on the PREFIX (`spec.check result=`), not on line position.
3. Defines the absence case: no verdict line present => treat as failure (non-zero exit is the forgery-proof signal; exit codes verified non-zero on every failure path).
4. Still distinguishes the verdict from `validate status=…` (the original bug this epic exists to fix).
5. Byte-identical on every surface.

Proposed wording (refine if you can do better while keeping 1-5):
"The verdict is the last stdout line starting with `spec.check result=` — not `validate status=…`. A non-zero exit means failure even if no verdict line appears."

Surfaces to update (all 25 occurrences): lib/specled_ex/prime.ex, lib/specled_ex/next.ex, test/mix/tasks/spec_prime_task_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/spec_next_task_test.exs, .spec/specs/prime.spec.md, .spec/specs/next.spec.md, .spec/AGENTS.md, .claude/rules/specled.md, docs/adoption.md (x3), docs/concepts.md, docs/coverage.md, skills/spec-led-bootstrap/SKILL.md (x3), references/adoption-phases.md (x3), references/detection-matrix.md, references/configurable-levers.md (x2).

ALSO (U9, same files): docs/coverage.md:47 appends the sentence to a paragraph about `mix spec.cover.test` exit codes, but spec.cover.test never emits a verdict line (print_verdict exists only in spec.check.ex/spec.validate.ex) — relocate it to a real spec.check passage in that file or drop that occurrence. Same for the mid-list occurrence in configurable-levers.md if it lands on an unrelated passage.

Also consider hoisting the sentence to ONE shared constant in lib/ referenced by prime.ex, next.ex and both test files (CF3) — it contains U+2014 and U+2026, so retyped copies can differ invisibly.

OUT OF SCOPE: the tier=usage grammar change, tagged_tests attribution fixes, drain-helper channel work, fixture severity mix (all batched to the fast-follow). No lib/ behavior change beyond the sentence constant.

NOTE (out-of-repo handoff): .claude/rules/specled.md is agent-rules-sync-managed. The in-repo edit is correct, but the vault source at ~/dev/mz/agentic-dotfiles/llms/workflows/agent-rules/rules/specled.md needs the identical reword or the next sync reverts it. Record this in the completion record; the orchestrator applies it.

Verification: mix compile --warnings-as-errors && mix test && mix format --check-formatted && mix deps.unlock --check-unused && mix spec.check (bare). Plus: prove by execution that the new sentence is true on a failure path (run spec.check with a bad --base under 2>&1 and confirm the sentence text accurately describes what a reader sees).
